_doc: ec fill (claude/fill-high-street, 20 Nov): which business or service is behind which shop / civic door of the ec

rooms.label: snackbar
rooms.name: Shoreline Snack Bar
rooms.why: hot dogs, fries, ice cream and cold drinks where the beach walk from the v -400 crossing meets the promenade; people eat on its terrace or carry it down to the sand

rooms.label: cafe
rooms.name: Dune Cafe
rooms.why: coffee, iced tea and sandwiches on the promenade where the beach walk from the v -200 crossing arrives; the terrace looks over the dune to the sea

rooms.label: rentals
rooms.name: South Beach Rentals
rooms.why: kayaks, paddle boards, umbrellas and boogie boards for hire at the south access, the one the people from the waterfront use; its racks stand in its yard and at the water
